subject: Rev-share eligibility + lead claim process for Harpoon connector
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@harpoonlabs.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@harpoonlabs.com>, procurement@harpoonlabs.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Harpoon x Redwood — rev-share proposal for connector launch

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team loved the latency numbers. Harpoon is keen to move forward with a connector that we can bundle into our marketplace and offer as an included integration to our enterprise customers.

High-level ask: we'd like to propose a standard rev-share for leads that convert from Harpoon referrals into paid Redwood Dedicated or Hosted usage. Our initial thinking is 20% net revenue for 12 months for referred accounts introduced by Harpoon, with a registration window of 90 days and a 12 month clawback for chargebacks/cancellations.

Attached is a one-page commercial summary and an initial integration scope spreadsheet. Can you confirm if that rev-share percent fits into Redwood's channel framework? Also, what information do you need from us to support lead registration and validation?

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Partnerships, Harpoon Labs

Harpoon Labs | olivia@harpoonlabs.com | +1 415-555-0142
From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Harpoon x Redwood — rev-share proposal for connector launch

Hi Olivia — great to hear and thanks for the summary. Quick answers up front: 20% is within the realm of our tiered referral framework for ISV connectors, but final percentage depends on (a) whether Harpoon requires exclusive attribution for a vertical, and (b) expected deal size / ARR profile.

What we need for smooth registration/validation:
- Lead form details: contact name, company domain, expected ARR band, MQL source = 'Harpoon Connector', date of first intro.
- Proof of intro: email thread or signed intro note (we accept HubSpot activity IDs).
- For co-sell credits: demo logs / joint meeting invite that includes a Harpoon rep.

Operational ask: please confirm whether Harpoon wants a 90-day discovery-to-registration window or 180 days — our default is 120 days for marketplace-introduced leads. Also attaching a short template for lead registration to speed approvals.

Next step: Ben — can you flag any constraints on rev-share duration and clawback? Marissa — can you add marketplace listing cadence to the onboarding checklist?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, Olivia Park <olivia@harpoonlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harpoon x Redwood — rev-share proposal for connector launch

Looping in the commercial details. Short version: we can support 20% on net new ARR for 12 months, but we need to define net revenue (we use net of credits/discounts + excludes overage credits). A few operational notes: 

- Eligibility: Rev-share applies only to customers who sign through Redwood's hosted API or our Dedicated contracts, not trials unless converted to paid within the registration window.
- Registration window: we prefer 120 days; can extend to 180 for channel partners after an initial vetting period.
- Clawback: standard is 12 months pro-rata if the customer cancels within the first year. We also require a 45-day window to process refunds before applying clawbacks.

Attachments: commercial terms template (PDF) and a short sample redline. We'll need Harpoon's legal to redline and return.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Park <olivia@harpoonlabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@harpoonlabs.com>, procurement@harpoonlabs.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harpoon x Redwood — rev-share proposal for connector launch

Thanks Ben & Irene — that all sounds reasonable. A few counterpoints from Harpoon legal/procurement: 

- We prefer 18 months on rev-share for integrations listed in our marketplace (longer tail). Could we propose 18 months at 18% instead of 12 months at 20%?
- For lead registration, Harpoon wants the option to register a lead up to 180 days if we can show continuous engagement (tracked meeting invites).
- Exclusivity: Harpoon will not ask for exclusivity, but we do request a 30-day notice before Redwood lists any competing connector as 'Harpoon certified' (branding use).

We're attaching a lightly redlined commercial summary. Jacob (cc'd) will handle contracting — can you share a DocuSign link or return the redline to procurement@harpoonlabs.com?

Cheers,
Olivia
From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia@harpoonlabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, procurement@harpoonlabs.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harpoon x Redwood — Rev-share eligibility + lead claim process for Harpoon connector

Olivia — thanks for the redline and the flexibility. Summary of what we heard and next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Commercial: Redwood proposes 18 months at 18% for marketplace-listed integrations, contingent on minimal integration SLAs (uptime > 99.5% for connector endpoints) and a joint marketplace listing commitment within 90 days of go-live.
2) Registration / eligibility: accept Harpoon's extended 180-day registration window if Harpoon provides evidence of continuous engagement (meeting invites, recorded demos, or HubSpot activity IDs). Lead registration template (attached) must be completed at time of first contact.
3) Clawback: 12 months pro-rata with a 45-day processing window for refunds; clawbacks apply to the rev-share payments only.
4) Branding / exclusivity: no exclusivity; Redwood will provide 30-day notice for any competing 'Harpoon certified' badges.

Action items: 
- Harpoon legal to return a signed/redlined commercial term sheet by 10 Aug.
- Redwood legal (Ben) will prepare a DocuSign envelope; expected turnaround 3 business days once we receive the redline.
- Marissa to open marketplace onboarding ticket and schedule the listing cadence call.

Attachments included: harpoon_revshare_draft_v1.pdf, harpoon_integration_scope.xlsx, lead_registration_template.xlsx

If that summary looks right I can route to legal and Ben will spin up DocuSign.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Partnerships
